69class Message {
70public:
71 static constexpr uint32_t kMessageMagic = 0xB8C16F47;
72 static constexpr uint32_t kMaxFrameLength = 8192;
73
74 class Frame {
75 public:
76 explicit Frame(size_t len, const void *init_data = nullptr)
77 : data_(std::make_shared<std::vector<uint8_t>>(
78 (len < kMaxFrameLength) ? len : kMaxFrameLength))
79 {
80 if (init_data)
81 set_data(init_data, len);
82 }
83
84 Frame() : Frame(0) {}
85 virtual ~Frame() = default;
86
87 size_t len() const { return data_->size(); }
88
89 uint8_t *data() const { return data_->data(); }
90 std::string str() const { return std::string(reinterpret_cast<char *>(data()), len()); }
91
92 void set_size(size_t size) { data_->resize(size); }
93
94 void set_data(const void *data, size_t len)
95 {
96 set_size(len);
97 std::copy_n((uint8_t *)data, len, data_->data());
98 }
99
100 virtual std::ostream &print(std::ostream &os) const
101 {
102 return os << "size=" << len() << " use_count=" << data_.use_count();
103 }
104
105 private:
106 std::shared_ptr<std::vector<uint8_t>> data_ = nullptr;
107 }; // class Frame

109 struct Header {
110 uint32_t magic = kMessageMagic; // magic value
111 uint32_t type = 0; // message type
112 uint32_t len = 0; // total length of the message (excluding topic & header)
113 };
114
115 Message() {}
116
117 explicit Message(Type type) : m_type(type) {}
118
119 Message(Type type, std::initializer_list<Frame> frames) : Message(type)
120 {
121 for (auto f : frames)
122 Add(f);
123 }
124
125 virtual ~Message() = default;
126
127 void Add(Frame &frame) { m_frames.push_back(frame); }
128
129 void Clear() { m_frames.clear(); }
130
131 // Get the first frame
132 Frame frame() const { return m_frames.empty() ? Frame() : m_frames.back(); }
133
134 // Accessors & Mutators
135 const Header header() const
136 {
137 Header hdr;
138 hdr.type = uint32_t(m_type);
139 for (const auto &f : m_frames)
140 hdr.len += f.len();
141 return hdr;
142 }
143
144 uint32_t len() const { return header().len; }
145 Type type() const { return m_type; }
146
147 std::vector<Frame> &frames() const { return m_frames; }
148
149 virtual std::ostream &print(std::ostream &os) const
150 {
151 std::stringstream ss;
152 ss << " type : " << uint32_t(type()) << std::endl;
153 ss << " len : " << len() << std::endl;
154 ss << " frames : " << m_frames.size() << std::endl;
155
156 return os << ss.str();
157 }
158
159private:
160 Type m_type = Type::Invalid;
161 mutable std::vector<Frame> m_frames;
162};

198 struct Metadata {
199 uint8_t version = kVersion;
200 uint16_t cookie = 0; // cookie that maps to CMDU to IEEE1905 message id
201 uint8_t dst[ETH_ALEN] = {0}; // destination mac address
202 uint8_t src[ETH_ALEN] = {0}; // source mac address
203 uint16_t ether_type = 0; // e.g. IEEE1905, LLDP, etc.
204 uint16_t msg_type = 0; // IEEE1905 messageType
205 uint8_t relay : 1; // IEEE1905 relayIndicator
206 uint8_t
207 preset_message_id : 1; // messageId is already set in the IEEE1905 header (set this bit when sending a Reply)
208 uint8_t _reserved : 6;
209 uint8_t if_type = 0; // interface type (use InterfaceType enum)
210 uint32_t if_index = 0; // network interface index (set to 0 to let transport decide)
211 uint16_t length =
212 0; // payload length (including IEEE1905 header, excluding Ethernet header)
213 uint64_t received_time = {}; // time since epoch (in seconds) when a packet was received.
214 };
215
216 explicit CmduXxMessage(Type type, std::initializer_list<Frame> frames = {})
217 : Message(type, frames)
218 {
219 // maximum one frame is allowed (if none are given we will allocate one below)
220 mapf_assert(this->frames().size() <= 1);
221
222 if (this->frames().empty()) {
223 Message::Frame frame(sizeof(Metadata));
224 Add(frame);
225 } else if (this->frames().back().len() < sizeof(Metadata)) {
226 this->frames().back().set_size(sizeof(Metadata));
227 }
228 }
229
230 Metadata *metadata() const { return reinterpret_cast<Metadata *>(frames().back().data()); };
231
232 uint8_t *data() const
233 {
234 mapf_assert(!frames().empty());
235
236 frames().back().set_size(sizeof(Metadata) + metadata()->length);
237 return frames().back().data() + sizeof(Metadata);
238 };
239

244 std::stringstream ss;
245 Metadata *m = metadata();

247 ss << " version : " << (unsigned)m->version << std::endl;
248 ss << " cookie : " << m->cookie << std::endl;

253 << (unsigned)m->dst[2] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
254 << (unsigned)m->dst[3] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
255 << (unsigned)m->dst[4] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
256 << (unsigned)m->dst[5] << std::endl;
257 ss << " src : " << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
258 << (unsigned)m->src[0] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
259 << (unsigned)m->src[1] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
260 << (unsigned)m->src[2] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
261 << (unsigned)m->src[3] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
262 << (unsigned)m->src[4] << ":" << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
263 << (unsigned)m->src[5] << std::endl;
264 ss << " ether_type : " << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(4) << m->ether_type
